step_1.tier1: Your drone needs a destination. The ore is somewhere on the map.
step_1.tier2: Use nearest_ore() to find ore, then move_to(...) to go there.

step_2.tier1: Mining happens at the ore tile, after you've arrived.
step_2.tier3:
Add on a new line:
  mine()

step_3.tier1: One ore isn't enough. Python can repeat code with a loop.
step_3.tier2: while cargo() < 5: repeats until cargo reaches 5.

step_4.tier1: The drone can only hold 5 ore at a time. capacity() returns 5.
step_4.tier2: When cargo() >= capacity(), the drone is full.
step_4.tier4: Check cargo() >= capacity() to know when to return to base.

step_5.tier1: When the drone is full, it needs to go back to base.
step_5.tier2: move_to("base") sends the drone to the green zone.

step_6.tier1: At the base, you can empty the drone's cargo.
step_6.tier2: deposit() empties your cargo at the base.

step_7.tier1: Combine everything: mine until full, return, deposit, repeat until 20.
step_7.tier2: Use while True: to loop forever. The game stops you at 20.
